RIGHTS REPRESENTED HEREBY WILL EXPIRE JUNE 15, 1932
No. 317
-10-
20ths
of a Share
SCRIP CERTIFICATE
For Capital Stock of
Pan American Airways Corporation
(Incorporated under the laws of the State of Delaware)
The Chase National Bank of the City of New York
THIS CERTIFIES that
-JAMES H. RAND-
-or assigns,
has an interest to the extent of.
..-TEN-
.....twentieths of a share in the shares of full paid and non-assessable capital stock, without
par value, of PAN AMERICAN AIRWAYS CORPORATION (a Delaware corporation), hereinafter referred to as the Company, hold by the undersigned for the account of the rogis-
tered holders of this and other similar scrip certificates and is entitled to the following, but no other, rights in respect of such interost:
At any time prior to the sale, as hereinafter set forth, of the shares of capital stock of the Company held by the undersigned in respect of this and olier similar scrip cer-
tificates at the time outstanding, upon surrender to the undersigned at its office, No. 11 Broad Street, New York, N. Y., of this scrip certificate with other like soir cecif ats sued oy
the undersigned, duly endorsed and stamped, calling in the aggregate for one or more full shares of such capital stock, the holder hereof will be entitled to receive, in exchange theretor
(a) a stock certificate or certificates for the aggregate number of full shares of capital stock of the Company, as constituted at the date hereof, called for by the scrip certifates so
surrendered, and (b) a new scrip certificate issued by the undersigned, bearing the same date as this scrip certificate for any fraction of a share of such capital stock called for by the
scrip certificates so surrendered.
Any dividends received by the undersigned upon the shares of capital stock of the Company represented by the stock certificate or certificates so
delivered which shall have been declared payable to the holder of such shares of record as of the date prior to the surrender of such scrip certificates will be paid • or on the order C
the holder of such scrip certificates upon surrender thereof as aforesaid.
2.
At any time after the sale by the undersigned, as hereinafter set forth, of the shares of stock held by it in respect of this and other like scrip certificates Issed "y hr unde
signed, the holder of this certificate upon surrender hereof as aforesaid shall be entitled to receive the proportion applicable to the fraction of a share of capital stock of the Company
with respect to which this scrip certificate was issued, of (a) the net cash proceeds from the sale of such sharos, and (b) any dividends received by the undersigned.. respect of such
shares which shall have been declared payable to the holders of such shares of record as of a date prior to the sale thereof by the undersigned.
At any time after June 15, 1932, the undersigned may sell, at public or private sale, without notice to the holder hereof, for the account of the holders of this an- omer similar
scrip certificates, the shares of capital stock of the Company held by the undersigned hereunder and thereunder.
In case any subscription rights shall be received by the undersigned with respect to the shares of capital stock of the Company from time to time held by the ur lesigned in
respect of this scrip certificate and other like scrip certificates issued by the undersigned, the undersigned will endeavor to sell such subscription rights, as soon as possifle -fte-t ceipt
thereof, either at public or private sale, as the undersigned in its discretion may determine, without notice to the holder hereof, and the net cash proceeds of any such sale shall be
distributed proportionately among the holders of scrip certificates entitled thereto.
This scrip certificate shall not entitle the hoider to any voting or other rights of a stockholder of the Company, or, except as herein expressly provided, to ary right receive
any stock of the Company or any payment of money. The undersigned shall not be required to pay interest on any sums of money payable hereunder and all sums hela by if under-
signed in respect of this and other like scrip certificates issued by the undersigned shall be so held by it as a general deposit.
said, any sums in respect of dividends upon the shares of stock held by it hereunder and under other like scrip certificates, or of the proceeds from the sale of shares or subscription richts
sold as aforesaid, until such dividends or proceeds shall have been actually received.
This certificate is transferable only on the books of the undersigned by the registered holder hereof in person or by duly authori.
endorsed and stamped for transfer.
attorney, upon surrender we. of, properly

Dated, New York City. October, 30. 1931.
Assistant Cashier.
